summary: Fase 1 'Central de Comando' full-pass testing. Backend: 40/40 pytest passed (14 command-center, 2 new extra tests for radar volume + multi-turn chat, 24 regression). Frontend Playwright: login->/dashboard, Central de Comando render (greeting/briefing/health 78 Saudavel/5-component breakdown expand+collapse), priority card 3 buttons, 3 insight cards with 6 evidence chips, data_scope 240/10/8, question input -> /chat?prompt, insight action -> /chat?prompt, /radar 9 alerts, /dados KPIs + 7 charts, /clientes 10 rows, /estoque 8 rows with 3 'Risco de ruptura' badges, new-user empty state + demo mode (banner, score 82, 4 insights, exit demo), mobile 390x844 (no horizontal overflow, 7 nav links in sheet). ONE HIGH bug found: navigating to /chat?prompt= fires the LLM stream 3x and renders a spurious error message inside the assistant answer.

minor.issue: No idempotency/dedup: the frontend's triple-fire results in 3 identical user messages persisted in chat_messages while only 1 assistant reply is stored, so history becomes inconsistent (user/assistant not paired) and is replayed to the model on the next turn ('Voce mandou varias perguntas juntas').

Health score credibility: demo company shows 78/100 'Saudavel' while /dados reports a monthly loss of -R$30.540,69 and margin -62%. _health_score() only checks sign of paid_balance for the 'financeiro' pillar and clamps margin at >=0 for 'vendas'/'eficiencia' (min(margin,25) with a +70/+65 base), so a heavily loss-making month still scores 'Saudavel'. Negative margin should push pillars down.
greeting is hardcoded 'Bom dia' regardless of time of day / timezone.

ui_bugs.issue: /radar, /clientes, /estoque, /financeiro are not in NAV_ITEMS, so the topbar title falls back to 'Sócio Digital' instead of the page name. /clientes and /estoque are also unreachable from the nav (only via radar alert links).
Guard is `if (!health?.score) return null` — a legitimate score of 0 renders nothing. Use `health?.score == null`.

integration_issues.flow: Central de Comando -> /chat?prompt= (Investigar comigo / insight action / question input)
integration_issues.issue: HIGH: one navigation fires POST /api/chat/stream 3 times (verified via request interception: 'chat/stream requests fired for ONE prompt: 3'). Result: 3x LLM cost/latency, duplicate user bubbles rendered, 3 duplicate user rows in chat history, and the aborted duplicate streams' catch handler overwrites the live assistant bubble so the answer renders as 'Desculpe, ocorreu um erro ao processar sua pergunta. Tente novamente.' + real answer. Manual send from the chat input fires exactly 1 request (correct), which isolates the defect to the prompt-param effect.

useChat.loadHistory() does setMessages(history) which replaces the optimistic [user, assistant-placeholder] pair appended by sendMessage, so deltas can be appended onto an OLD history message (observed: beginning of the answer lost, text started mid-sentence at 'risco de ruptura:').

In demo mode (new empty company) the insight/question buttons still navigate to /chat, which queries the REAL empty company, so the AI answers 'sem dados' while the screen shows demo insights. Demo greeting is also a hardcoded persona ('Bom dia, Mariana.') that does not match the logged-in user.

issues: 'Lucro do mês' shows '-R$ 30.540,69' with '450.3% vs mês anterior' and a down arrow — a 450% delta on a sign-flipping value is misleading; consider suppressing % when the previous period had the opposite sign.
'Contas a receber R$ 0,00' is rendered in green/positive styling.
LLM markdown tables are rendered as raw pipe-delimited text (| Produto | Estoque | ... |) — the message renderer does not support tables.
One answer leaked an unresolved placeholder: 'Seu estoque tem [X] produtos'.

action_items: FIX (HIGH) ChatPage.jsx: the effect deps [loadHistory, prompt, sendMessage] re-run when loadHistory identity changes (historyLoaded flips) plus StrictMode double-invoke => prompt sent 3x. Guard with a ref: `const sentRef = useRef(null); useEffect(() => { loadHistory(); }, []); useEffect(() => { if (prompt && sentRef.current !== prompt) { sentRef.current = prompt; sendMessage(prompt); } }, [prompt]);`

FIX (HIGH) useChat.js: (a) error/catch handlers mutate `updated[updated.length - 1]` — capture the target index when the placeholder is appended and update that index only; (b) loadHistory must merge instead of replacing messages (or refuse to run once a send is in flight) to stop wiping optimistic messages.
Consider clearing the ?prompt= query param after the first send so a page refresh does not re-ask the same question.
Revisit _health_score() so a negative margin / monthly loss lowers the financeiro/vendas/eficiencia pillars (78 'Saudavel' with a -R$30.5k month is not credible).
Add /radar (or /acoes), /clientes, /estoque to NAV_ITEMS or add a title map so the topbar does not fall back to 'Sócio Digital'.
HealthScore: change `!health?.score` guard to a null check so score 0 still renders.
Render markdown tables in the chat message renderer.
critical_code_review_comments: ChatPage useEffect includes unstable callbacks (loadHistory/sendMessage) in its dependency array — this is the direct cause of the triple LLM call; any effect that triggers a paid side-effect must be ref-guarded.
useChat.js updates the assistant message by array position ('last element'), which is unsafe when two streams/history loads are concurrent; index-based or id-based targeting is required.

chat_routes.py persists the user message BEFORE the LLM call and only persists the assistant reply if full_response is non-empty, so failed/duplicated requests leave orphan user rows that are then replayed as context in the next turn.
chat_routes.py line 18 `os.environ['EMERGENT_LLM_KEY']` at import time crashes the whole app if unset (carried over from iteration 1, still unfixed).

CommandCenterPage.jsx is one very long file with extremely dense single-line JSX (lines 37-48 each exceed 500 chars) — hurts reviewability; extract Header/QuestionBar/PriorityCard/DataScope subcomponents.
Demo data (DEMO_COMMAND_DATA) hardcodes greeting 'Bom dia, Mariana.' which overrides the real logged-in user's name when demo mode is enabled.

rca_of_the_issue: ChatPage.jsx runs `useEffect(() => { loadHistory(); if (prompt) sendMessage(prompt); }, [loadHistory, prompt, sendMessage])`. loadHistory is a useCallback with [historyLoaded] in its deps, so when historyLoaded flips false->true its identity changes and the effect re-runs, calling sendMessage(prompt) again; combined with React StrictMode's double-invoke the prompt is sent 3 times (verified: 3 POST /api/chat/stream for one navigation, and 3 identical user rows in GET /api/chat/history). The duplicate streams then collide in useChat: its delta/error handlers always write to `messages[messages.length - 1]`, so when one stream's fetch is aborted/fails its catch handler overwrites the bubble that another stream is still filling, producing 'Desculpe, ocorreu um erro ao processar sua pergunta. Tente novamente.' prepended to the real answer. Additionally loadHistory's `setMessages(history)` replaces the optimistic user+placeholder pair, so early deltas can be appended to a stale history message (observed answer truncated at the start). Mitigation: ref-guard the prompt send, split the history-load effect to run once with [], target the assistant message by captured index, and clear the ?prompt= param after sending.
